speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a penny. It is a full thumb short of the notch. I am not cutting another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Measure the loaf. I am not the loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. Eat. The reckoning is at five. A penny is the whole of the business on this board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three bites, then. The desk stays upstairs. I am not bringing it down.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I'll keep the rest under the cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Under the cloth. The jaw is the jaw. The clove is doing less than it did yesterday, and I am not calling that a cure.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Less is not a cure. Sit, and go when you must.
